question: top5 customers by revenue
sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_orders
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
), refund_totals AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunds
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.id, c.name,
       COALESCE(ot.total_orders, 0) - COALESCE(rt.total_refunds, 0) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt ON rt.customer_id = c.id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 customers
sql:
SELECT c.name, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 customers by reveune
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
